text: Soft, fluffy and gorgeous. Super quality and softness.  I have used for a while now and it remains like new!

features: CUTE COLOR & ULTRA SOFT: Wrapped or covered with Lvylov fluffy faux fur blankets while snuggling or relaxing in bed, it will take care of you gently on chilly nights. The faux animal pattern makes our full/queen size furry blanket with a cute appearance to complement your room with a chic feeling - Protect your luxury bed and couch.

COMFY REVERSE & DURABLE SEWING: Lovely 1.6 inches long shaggy fabric and ultra soft minky fleece reverse are seamlessly stitched together to make our lightweight full/queen fur blanket more durable and breathable. No shedding and fading. Great Christmas and holiday gift choices for yourself and your loved ones.

BLANKET SIZE & WIDELY USAGE: King size - 90"x 108" (230 * 270 cm), big enough for a king size bed as a decorative fur bed blanket to keep warm. Lvylov fuzzy faux fur blankets are perfect for snuggling up on the couch, sofa, bed, loveseat, chilled movie theater. Being able to take beautiful pictures on your social software as a photography prop, your pets will like the soft feeling of a long shaggy blanket as well.

MACHINE WASHABLE & EASY TO CARE: Our fluffy fur bed blanket was created with easy care. Machine wash on gentle cycle with cold water separately, then air dry. Note: Do not tumble dry, Do not Bleach, Do not Iron, Do not Heat. Wash it before use to avoid shedding.

LIFETIME SERVICE & REPLACEMENT POLICY: We are always ready to serve you. If you have any problems or dissatisfaction with these soft fur blankets, please feel free to contact us. Lvylov will provide a lifetime refund and replacement service for every product we sell.
